protocol.name: coverage-full-repair-v1
protocol.selection: All 50 frozen known tasks; fresh responses, fixed independent scoring; scoped public contract only for envvar
protocol.change: Fix qualified symbol filtering, reserve explicit targets and coupled protocols, reject empty/no-op patches; same budgets and independent scoring
protocol.unchanged: Same description and scoring; scoped public contract changes envvar validation; max 2 calls; 60000 total tokens, generation up to 32768 including reasoning; 65536 context and 1200s
protocol.limits: Known tasks; cloud alias not frozen weights; equal budget ceilings do not imply equal actual computation; independent stochastic outputs
protocol.order: Serial full-pool run; compare task outcomes with preceding complete high-thinking run, not a contemporaneous randomized comparison

identity.limits: Provider alias may change; fingerprint recorded per response
